singular VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: singular submit --witnesses FILE --koios-url URL --network-magic N
       [--koios-token-file FILE] [--network-time DIR] [--receipt FILE]
       [--trace LEVEL] [--trace-to SINK] [--trace-format FORMAT] BUNDLE

Send a signed bundle, print its receipt

Sends a bundle its signers witnessed. Each witness file, or each .witness file
of a directory, is matched to a transaction by its signature, and every check
runs before the first send: a witness for no transaction or for a key no
transaction needs, a missing witness, an input found nowhere and a body the
tip has expired (rebuild the bundle) are refused by name.

The transactions the chain does not hold are sent in the bundle's order, each
confirmed before the next; an uncertain answer stops the run as partial and
nothing is sent again, so running it again sends only the rest. It takes no
wallet key and no vault, and keeps no state.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

  A witness file from wallet sign, or a directory of them; give it once for
  each.
  option: --witnesses FILE

  Base URL of the Koios API used to read the chain and to submit.
  option: --koios-url URL

  The network: 1 for preprod, 42 for the generated development network.
  option: --network-magic N

  File holding a Koios bearer token; its contents are never printed.
  option: --koios-token-file FILE

  Directory with the pinned time-manifest.json, shelley-genesis.json and
  era-history.cbor.
  option: --network-time DIR
  default: the preprod recording packaged with the program

  Also write the JSON receipt to FILE.
  option: --receipt FILE

  How much to narrate: off, what (protocol steps) or how (also their
  mechanics).
  option: --trace LEVEL
  default: what on a terminal, otherwise off

  Where the narration goes: stderr or file:PATH; repeat for several.
  option: --trace-to SINK
  default: stderr

  The format of the narration: text for a person, json for a program.
  option: --trace-format FORMAT
  default: text on standard error, json in a file

  The bundle of unsigned transactions.
  argument: BUNDLE

Environment:
  SINGULAR_LOG  A file the protocol phases are appended to, one line each.

Example:
  singular submit bundle.json --witnesses witnesses \
      --koios-url https://preprod.koios.rest/api/v1 --network-magic 1

Output and exit status:
  The receipt is read back from the chain and printed as JSON on standard
  output.
  Exit status 0 on success, 2 for a command line it refused, otherwise the
  outcome class the receipt names: 10 refused before anything was sent,
  11 refused by the ledger, 12 node unavailable, 13 timeout, 14 stale state,
  15 partial, 16 another writer, 17 proof missing, 18 proof inconsistent,
  19 waiting for signatures.
